messages:
maya: Heads up — heatline on /metrics dashboard is stalling after the canary we pushed ~20:30 UTC. Frame drops ~2-4s, looks like main thread parse + long tasks.

sam: Yep repro'd in EU canary. Profiler shows big parse time in telemetry client bundle (~120ms) and a few decryption helper functions from the crypto polyfill.

liam: Also saw a gzip bundle delta: +72KB in vendor chunk. Rollup trace points to telemetry importing a native util that pulls in node-libs-shim.

julia: Did route-level KV cache miss rate change? We had a routing tweak yesterday to prefer org-based routing, might have changed cache key prefix.

maya: Good call — kvcache hit-rate dropped from ~92% -> 61% around the same deploy. Prefetch logs show keys are now prefixed with `org:1234:` instead of `route:/metrics:` so prefix mismatch.

sam: So two culprits: telemetry import causing parse + polyfill, and routing change causing cache misses inflating payloads. Both amplify latency.

liam: Quick mitigation proposal:
1) lazy-load telemetry on the chart mount with dynamic import (no top-level import)
2) restore route path into kvcache key generation OR add a compatibility shim to read both prefixes
3) ship a small devtool build that splits out the crypto helper into a separate chunk

julia: Agreed. For (1) do this:
```js
// before (problematic)
import telemetry from 'telemetry/client';
telemetry.init();

// after (lazy)
onChartMount(async () => {
  const telemetry = await import(/* webpackChunkName: "telemetry" */ 'telemetry/client');
  telemetry.init();
});
```
This moves parse cost off initial paint.

maya: I'll open the lazy-load PR now. Patch will be behind `ui.telemetry.lazyLoad` flag. @liam can you handle the bundle-split webpack hint? @sam can you revert the route-only routing tweak in a canary? Ops-bot: deploy-canary?

deploy-bot: build queued for `canary/heatline-telemetry-fix` — tracking id ci-8821

liam: Will push a quick chunking hint + smaller polyfill import. Expect ~-50KB gz in vendor.

sam: Reverting routing change in canary; monitoring kvcache hit-rate and 95p render latency. I'll report in 30m.

maya: Thanks — if canary looks good we can enable flag globally. :thumbsup: 

julia: Also add an eval for heatline render latency to Redwood Optimize so we catch regressions in future.

maya: Filed GH issues: #6124 lazy-load telemetry, #6125 kvcache-compat, #6126 chunk-split-telemetry

sam: Monitoring dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/metrics/heatline — updating every 1m

liam: +1, will push PR in next 45m. :rocket:
